d: A video from Lucknow has gone viral, showing a heated exchange between a woman and police personnel during VIP movement on November 21, when Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath were in the city. The woman was requesting access to the road, saying she needed to get medicine and a small child was waiting at home. However, a police personnel allegedly told her to wait because the Chief Minister was passing. The Lucknow Police took cognizance of the video and initiated departmental action against the personnel involved. But what are the rules for…
